Large errors for the basic aromatic rows 49201b5817f204116f7f and a17bcdddcf0799baeee2 motivate a larger matched nitrogen response curve in this batch.","batch_rationale":"The batch concentrates on measured failure regions that can generalize: aromatic nitrogen and amino-nitrile families receive matched weak-to-strong ratio probes; m159, m125, m131, m116, m177, and m198 supply local endpoint curves; m72, m199, and m135 test loading and completion behavior; and m208 probes transfer of donor-specific tails to another scaffold. Several choices pair high-ratio or high-loading conditions with weaker controls so retraining can learn onset and completion separately. Three compact heavy-atom controls provide calibration anchors and guard against spreading severe-tail corrections across ordinary rows. Together these experiments cover structural novelty, condition-response relationships, loading interactions, and both compact and delayed regions of the Row-distribution."}
